dhp21:1: Heedfulness is the Way to the Deathless; heedlessness is the way to death.
dhp21:3: The heedful never die, but they that are heedless are, as it were, dead already.
dhp22:1: Knowing this clearly, they that are advanced in heedfulness
dhp22:3: Delight in heedfulness, and rejoice in the state of the Elect.
dhp23:1: They that devote themselves to meditation, they that are persevering, they that put forth resolute effort.
dhp23:3: They, the wise, attain Nibbāna, the highest bliss.
dhp24:1: If a man exert himself, if he be ever mindful, if his deeds be pure, if he be circumspect of conduct,
dhp24:3: If he control himself, if he live in accordance with the Law, if he be heedful, his glory ever increases.
dhp25:1: By rousing himself, by heedfulness, by controlling himself, by restraining himself,
dhp25:3: A wise man may make for himself an island which the flood can never overwhelm.
dhp26:1: Simpletons, folk of little intelligence, are given to heedlessness;
dhp26:3: But the intelligent man preserves heedfulness as his greatest treasure.
dhp27:1: Give not yourselves up to heedlessness; indulge not in lust and sensual pleasure;
dhp27:3: For he that is heedful and practices meditation attains profound happiness.
dhp28:1: When the wise man banishes heedlessness by heedfulness,
dhp28:3: He climbs the terrace of wisdom, and free from sorrow, looks upon the sorrowing folk of the world.
dhp28:5: Steadfast, as though standing on a mountain-top, he gazes upon the simpletons standing on the ground below.
dhp29:1: Heedful among the heedless, watchful among the sleeping,
dhp29:3: Even as a racer outstrips a hack, even so goes a wise man.
dhp30:1: By heedfulness Maghavā attained leadership of the gods;
dhp30:3: All men praise heedfulness; heedlessness is ever reprobated.
dhp31:1: A monk who delights in heedfulness and views heedlessness with fear
dhp31:3: Advances like a fire, consuming attachments both small and great.
dhp32:1: A monk who delights in heedfulness and views heedlessness with fear,
dhp32:3: Is not liable to fall away, but is nigh even unto Nibbāna.
